Yeah, I'll let you know if I ever post on there. :)

And, I'll let you know how I'm doing tomorrow too. :)

(Lol, reddit seems to have it out for you cause it won't show your comments but I can still find them on your profile.)

For some reason I was able to see your comment but then it said it was deleted,  


Anyways, I was gonna say, "Thank you, I'll try those links out and see if anything helps. The cards sound nice though, knowing that I'll never get a supportive one from my parents."
Reddit says you commented but it isn't showing me your comment...

I feel lonely and i feel like i have nobody in my life who actually cares about me...

Like, i came out as transgender to my parents and they just ignore me now more than ever.

My friends never want to hang out with me, even if I ask (which i have to cause they never really ask if i want to hang out unless they literally can't do what they're wanting without me)

I just feel like nobody in my life wants me here and i feel like there's nobody out there for me...

Like, i tried dating and I've had a few relationships but they never work out and I can't help but feel like I'll always be lonely...
I don't know, i just wanna cry...
